name: Ice Age
description: The long freeze of Dominaria, magical in origin, ended by the World Spell.

timeline.summary: The war culminates in the Sylex Blast, plunging the world into the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: plunging the world into the Ice Age

timeline.summary: The Ice Age lasts until Freyalise casts her World Spell to end it.
timeline.quote: until Freyalise cast her World Spell to end it

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Brothers' War the Ice Age approaches Sarpadia, bringing dwindling resources and fighting among allies.
timeline.quote: The changing climate results in dwindling resources and fighting amongst allies for survival.

citation.text: "Fallen Empires", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lhurgoyfs spread across Dominaria during the Ice Age, adapting to a carrion diet, and later migrate north to the Northland.
timeline.quote: Lhurgoyfs spread across Dominaria during the Ice Age

citation.text: "Lhurgoyf", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise casts her World Spell, ending the Ice Age and forcing a cold-adapted population to adjust to warm weather.
timeline.quote: After the planeswalker Freyalise cast her World Spell , thereby ending the Ice Age
